Compile QC flags and run the full QC pipeline

Source: R/qc.R
rb_qc_pipeline.Rd

  • rb_compile_qc_flags(): Combines logical check columns into a pipe-delimited qc_flag column.

  • rb_run_qc_pipeline(): Runs the full QC pipeline in one call.

Usage

rb_compile_qc_flags(data, exclude_flags = NULL, max_ambiguous_frac = NULL)

rb_run_qc_pipeline(
  data,
  blast_db,
  numt_fasta = NULL,
  species_col = "species",
  gene_col = "seq_type",
  sequence_col = "sequence",
  id_col = "unique_code",
  min_divergence_seqs = 5,
  parallel_workers = 1,
  coding_genes = c("COI"),
  rrna_genes = c("12S", "16S")
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing sequences and check results.

exclude_flags

Character vector of flags that prevent "pass". NULL (default) uses the hard-flag set defined in the function body.

max_ambiguous_frac

Numeric scalar in [0, 1], or NULL (default). Optional exclusion threshold on the proportion of ambiguous (IUPAC) bases among called bases (frac_ambig). When supplied, records with frac_ambig > max_ambiguous_frac receive the ambiguous_excess flag and are excluded from the passing set. When NULL, ambiguity never excludes a record; it is reported only through the informational ambiguous_bases note and the n_ambiguous / frac_ambig metadata columns. Requires the frac_ambig column to be present.

blast_db

Path to a BLAST database.

numt_fasta

Path to a NUMT FASTA file.

species_col, gene_col, sequence_col, id_col

Column names.

min_divergence_seqs

Minimum sequences for divergence analysis.

parallel_workers

Number of parallel workers.

coding_genes, rrna_genes

Gene types for checks.

Value

The input data frame data with two columns added:

qc_flag

Character. Pipe-delimited excluding flags, or "pass" if none fired. This is the field consumed by rb_get_sequences().

qc_note

Character. Pipe-delimited informational flags, or NA_character_ if none fired.

Details

Flags are partitioned into two classes. Hard flags (contaminant, numt, internal_stop, frameshifted, sequence_short, divergent, manual_review_needed, check_failed) prevent a record from being labelled "pass". Soft flags (sequence_gap, ambiguous_bases, frame_incomplete, tree_error) describe properties or tooling limitations that do not disqualify a record. Only excluding flags are written to qc_flag.

See also

Other quality control: rb_qc_checks, rb_qc_screening

Examples

d <- data.frame(
  is_contaminant = FALSE, is_numt = FALSE,
  has_stop = FALSE, frameshifted = FALSE, has_short = FALSE,
  div_result = NA_character_, seq_type = "12S",
  n_gap_chars = 0L, n_ambiguous = 2L, frac_ambig = 0.01,
  frame_complete = NA, codon_check_run = NA
)
out <- rb_compile_qc_flags(d)
out$qc_flag   # "pass"
#> [1] "pass"
out$qc_note   # "ambiguous_bases"
#> [1] "ambiguous_bases"

d$is_contaminant <- TRUE
rb_compile_qc_flags(d)$qc_flag   # "contaminant"
#> [1] "contaminant"
